data: At which of the following number of RC instances is the F1 score of NewsQA greater than SQuAD?

Wait a moment, let me verify this. The red line represents SQuAD, and the blue line represents NewsQA. I need to compare their F1 scores at different numbers of RC instances. At approximately 5000 RC instances, the blue line (NewsQA) is above the red line (SQuAD). As we move along the x-axis, the gap between the two lines remains consistent, with the blue line consistently above the red line. Therefore, the F1 score of NewsQA is greater than SQuAD across all the shown data points.
The answer is 5000.
